rules: Only explicit v3 preregistration carries the required execution_scope; old v1/v2 envelopes never satisfy this entrypoint.
execution_scope contains the environment ID and the fixed local-claim contract hash, forbids cross-host execution and temporary store overrides.
The complete scope remains inside runtime_plan_core and full runtime-plan commitments, and therefore inside the signed grant/consumption graph. No scope field is omitted.
Public verification is readonly, validates at an explicit supplied time and never provisions or reserves a real store.
The immutable scoped proof derives local-claim request hashes from the verified signed documents; callers cannot substitute grant, authorization ID, execution commit or environment ID.
Clock-domain selection is still a future runtime-factory responsibility; constructing request bytes is not clock provenance or permission.
The real store must be checked against signed environment scope after current source/review/first-live admission and fresh-time checks; then make the one-shot claim before Key/task use.
Any source/admission failure, absent/mismatched store or old unscoped authorization must fail closed; no fallback to worktree-local storage.
The existing v2 verifier and all predecessor schema files remain unchanged in accepted document versions.
